claim: A lower, fixed, uniform beta (coupling's trigger probability, in place of coupling-v2's beta=0.5) -- with the coupling-v2 identity-mapping target rule (target = prev_last), boundary-shift-v2, and the substitution top-up (nu_sub=0.01) otherwise unchanged -- can be found in the pilot grid below that (a) still clears the edge criterion (gain >= 0.15 bits/boundary, >= 15/16 positive blocks) and (b) at full 20-seed primary evaluation, passes all six frozen criteria in at least 16 of 20 replicates with strictly greater H2 headroom (distance from the 2.8397-bit tolerance ceiling) than coupling-v2's own primary configuration's headroom of 0.0083 bits.
honesty_precommitment: If no beta in the pilot grid clears the edge criterion, that is reported as a negative result closing off the lower-fixed-beta approach entirely -- not retried with an expanded grid without a fresh precommitment. If a qualifying beta is found but the primary run's H2 headroom is not clearly larger than coupling-v2's own, that is also reported as a negative result for this specific lever, not reframed as partial success. This design does not attempt section-varying beta -- a further, still-open, separately-scoped step contingent on this pilot succeeding.
base_mechanism: Naibbe cipher (voynich-units commit 956a7c4fc39981f4d116fa3f4edfccce6d065571) + coupling-v2 identity-mapping boundary-coupling rule (target = prev_last, 26 distinct possible targets) + boundary-shift-v2 + substitution top-up, all unchanged from hybrid-shift-coupling-v2-substitution except beta.

representation.roundtrip_required: collapse(expand(atom)) == atom for every atomic_alphabet symbol

coupling_v3.rule: identical to coupling-v2 (target = prev_last), only beta changes
coupling_v3.selection_rule: the lowest beta in the pilot grid that clears the edge criterion (mean gain over 3 pilot seeds >= 0.15 bits/boundary) becomes the frozen primary beta -- lowest, not best-looking, to maximize H2 headroom while still respecting the edge floor; if multiple tie on clearing the floor, the lowest wins by this same rule with no further selection freedom
